text:
alex: heads up, prod eu2 rollout tightened egress rules via TF and were seeing GPU nodes fail to reach the privatelink keystore proxy. warmpool joins are timing out.
maria: error seen on node boot: "keystore: KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied from proxy 10.2.8.7". provisioning queue increasing.
devin: quick skim of the TF diff shows module/egress changed keystore_proxies cidr from 10.2.0.0/16 to a list of /28s for tighter control; looks like some proxy IPs are outside the new list.
ops-oncall: opening INC-6007. mitigation plan: temporarily add an explicit egress rule allowing gpu-subnets -> 10.2.0.0/16:443. Need emergency sign-off.
alex: emergency approved. do the manual rule and we revert via pipeline PR.
devin: running CLI add now:
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-gpu --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
ops-oncall: rule added. warmpool is rejoining, +4 nodes healthy. provisioning backlog dropping.
maria: note: the keystore proxy also dropped telemetry during the outage; audit events for keystore.decrypt between 2026-03-23T12:04:00 and 12:20:00 are missing. filing SIEM ticket SIEM-1330.
audit-bot: SIEM-1330 created, retention flagged for re-ingest; assigned to platform-telemetry.
devin: I pushed a PR https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/950 that reintroduces the /16 superset rule and pins per-AZ proxy cidrs in a variable set. also added a canary job that curls keystore health via proxy from a GPU canary ak47 image.
sre-bot: FYI automated autoscaler created fallback nodes in us-east when eu2 failed; cross-region model shard pulls ~900GB (estimate). devops-costs: +$1.3k.
alex: include that in the retro. also we need a preflight validation in the terraform pipeline that resolves proxies via internal DNS and ensures CIDR superset.
devin: filing INFRA-484 for TF preflight and INFRA-485 for rollout canary smoke (per-AZ).
ops-oncall: INC-6007 -> mitigated; keeping open until SIEM confirms backfill. will follow up with PR merge after review.
maria: one small follow-up: let's add a CI assertion that prevents shrinking a CIDR range that currently contains active endpoints (simple check using list of known proxy IPs). I can prototype.
alex: yes, prototyping that would be great. thanks all.
ops-oncall: will update INC-6007 and SIEM-1330 when re-ingest completes.
sre-bot: INC-6007 resolved by ops-oncall at 2026-03-23T12:26:40Z (monitoring stable).
